the_inescapable_conclusion.name: The Inescapable Conclusion
the_inescapable_conclusion.narrationHints: You lay the premises down one at a time, each one they must agree to, until they arrive — of their own reasoning — at a conclusion they would have run from if they'd seen it coming.
the_inescapable_conclusion.description: The Syllogist art of the inescapable argument — a chain of reasoning so sound that agreeing to the start compels agreeing to the end, binding a mind by its own logic. Not deception; the opposite. The trap is that it is TRUE.
the_inescapable_conclusion.notFor: It binds only the reasonable — a mind that will simply refuse a true conclusion cannot be caught by one. And a true argument binds you too; you cannot walk someone to a conclusion you are unwilling to stand on yourself.

tree.name: The Inescapable Conclusion
tree.grants: Bind a reasoning mind to a conclusion by an argument it cannot honestly escape.
tree.cannot: It fails against those who refuse reason itself, it binds its wielder to the same truth, and a conclusion someone was walked into by force of logic can curdle into resentment of the one who walked them.

tree.name: The Standing Proof
tree.grants: Walk a whole body of reasoning minds to the same conclusion at once — a council, a court, a school — and the binding holds against later private doubt, because each of them watched the others agree. The chain can be built across days now rather than one exchange.
tree.cannot: It still fails entirely against those who will simply refuse a true conclusion, and a group holds more of them than a person does. It binds you to the same truth, publicly and on the record. And a conclusion a body was walked into together curdles together — the Syllogists have begun more than one schism this way.

rankDeltas.delta: WALK A WHOLE BODY OF REASONING MINDS to the same conclusion AT ONCE — a council, a court, a school

intensity.conserve: make the argument — half the binding, and they can still walk away thinking
intensity.surge: double it; IT STILL FAILS ENTIRELY against those who will simply REFUSE

bounds.text: IT FAILS AGAINST THOSE WHO REFUSE REASON ITSELF
it binds A REASONING MIND — the unreasoning are outside it entirely

the_inescapable_conclusion.plainly: A social/investigate action that weakens or restricts a target. Its strength is rated 7 out of 10 It affects 1 target, and lasts for about 6 hours Ranks: rank 2 extends targets. Limit: iT Fails Against Those Who Refuse Reason Itself.

the_proof.name: The Proof
the_proof.narrationHints: You assemble it whole — the complete proof, every step airtight, of a thing that is simply TRUE — and lay it before the world, and the world has no honest answer but to accept it.
the_proof.description: The Syllogist capstone — a complete, irrefutable proof of a true thing, assembled and offered so soundly that no honest mind can deny it. The deepest gift of the logical kind, and the loneliest: to be right past all argument is to be right, often, alone.
the_proof.notFor: One proof, once, at enormous cost — it can only prove what is actually true; there is no proof of a falsehood, only clever forgery that the next sound mind unpicks. And a proof, once offered, is loose in the world; you cannot un-prove a thing.

tree.name: The Proof
tree.grants: Assemble and offer a complete, irrefutable proof of a true thing.
tree.cannot: It proves only the true, it costs nearly all you have, and to be irrefutably right is a lonely country — the proof convinces, but conviction is not love.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: ASSEMBLE AND OFFER A COMPLETE, IRREFUTABLE PROOF of a true thing. The capstone is a KIND (irrefutability itself) at near-total cost.

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — a partial proof is an argument, and arguments are what the Cathedral survives.
intensity.surge: REFUSED — it already costs nearly all you have.

bounds.text: IT PROVES ONLY THE TRUE
it costs your whole remaining energy pool and leaves you at zero, unable to use any craft until you rest a full night

the_proof.plainly: A investigate/social action that reveals information or sets up a later action. Its strength is rated 9 out of 10, and lasts for about 2 hours Limit: iT Proves Only The True.

the_closing_argument.name: The Closing Argument
the_closing_argument.narrationHints: Every step is one they agreed to. That is what makes the last step impossible to refuse.
the_closing_argument.description: ⚠️ THE CORNERS' CRAFT. A Syllogist walks a person, honestly, from premises they already hold to a conclusion that ends them — that the work was worthless, that they cannot be forgiven, that the only consistent act remaining is the one they will now perform. NOTHING IN IT IS FALSE. That is the whole horror.
the_closing_argument.notFor: Anyone who will not reason — the unreasonable are genuinely immune and the Corners resent it. And it CANNOT USE A FALSE PREMISE: the argument must be sound or it does nothing at all.

tree.name: The Closing Argument
tree.grants: Walk them, honestly, to a conclusion that unmakes their footing. They cannot act against it while it holds.
tree.cannot: A false premise. Anyone who refuses to follow.

tree.name: The Only Consistent Act
tree.grants: Reach the conclusion where the consistent act is a final one — and STOP TALKING. What they do next is theirs.
tree.cannot: Making them. It is their hand and both of you know it.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ THE ONLY KILL IN THE CATALOG THE WIELDER DOES NOT PERFORM. Resolve as a hobble; the lethal outcome is the target's OWN act, gated on the argument being sound and the target being a reasoner. The engine should never render it as damage dealt.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: the conclusion where the only consistent act is final — and you stop talking

intensity.conserve: walk them partway — shaken, and they can turn back
intensity.surge: reach the end; IT IS THEIR HAND, AND BOTH OF YOU KNOW IT

bounds.text: IT CANNOT USE A FALSE PREMISE — an unsound argument does nothing
THE UNREASONABLE ARE IMMUNE
YOU DO NOT PERFORM IT. IT IS THEIR HAND, AND BOTH OF YOU KNOW IT

the_closing_argument.plainly: A social contest against the target's resolve. You must be able to state a sound argument from something they already believe — the GM judges soundness, and an unsound argument fails automatically. On a win they cannot act against that conclusion for the rest of the scene. At rank 2, if the conclusion is that a final act is the only consistent one, the GM decides whether the target performs it; you never roll for that part. The target may disengage from the conversation at any time, and anyone who refuses to reason is immune outright.

the_stated_case.name: The Stated Case
the_stated_case.narrationHints: You lay a matter out so completely that the conclusion is simply visible, and there is nothing left to argue about — not because you won, but because the shape of it is now in the room.
the_stated_case.description: The Syllogists' building-craft, opposite to their unmaking one: not the flaw named, but the case made.
the_stated_case.notFor: Making a false case hold (a Syllogist who does this is a Veilwright and is treated as one); convincing people who do not care about being right; brevity.

tree.name: The Laid-Out Case
tree.grants: Set a matter out in full to people willing to follow. Disputes resolve; a council decides; a wrong belief comes apart without anyone being humiliated.
tree.cannot: It needs TIME and an audience that will follow reasoning. The uninterested, the frightened, and the paid are immune. And the case must be SOUND — you cannot build this out of nothing.

tree.name: The Standing Argument
tree.grants: Build it to last — write it, teach it, leave it. It goes on convincing people after you have left the room.
tree.cannot: A standing argument can be answered by a better one, and you have given them the shape to answer. Syllogists consider that a feature.

tree.name: The Settled Question
tree.grants: A case so complete a community stops relitigating it. Feuds end this way; so do bad laws.
tree.cannot: ⚠ A SETTLED QUESTION SETTLES FOR EVERYONE, including people who were living well off it being open. And the Grand Lattice regards settled questions as their own property.

intensity.surge: settle the question; IT SETTLES FOR EVERYONE, including those living off it being open

bounds.text: needs TIME and an audience that will follow
the case must be SOUND — you cannot build it from nothing
the uninterested, the frightened and the PAID are immune

the_stated_case.plainly: A social/puzzle action that resolves a dispute by laying the whole case out. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about a day.

the_followed_thread.name: The Followed Thread
the_followed_thread.narrationHints: Given what is true now, you follow it to what must therefore be true. Not prophecy — CONSEQUENCE. The world is more determined than people find comfortable, and Syllogists find that restful.
the_followed_thread.description: The Syllogists' seeing-craft: inference run far enough forward to arrive before the event does.
the_followed_thread.notFor: Anything genuinely undetermined (a free choice not yet made, a Churn-touched outcome); working from premises you have not checked; certainty about people.

tree.name: The Next Step
tree.grants: From what you actually know, name what must follow — the shortage three weeks out, the betrayal the arrangement requires, the collapse the load implies.
tree.cannot: GARBAGE IN. A wrong premise gives a confident wrong answer, and this craft does not feel any different when it is wrong. Free choices break the thread.

tree.name: The Long Thread
tree.grants: Follow it further, through several turns, and see where a situation is actually going rather than where everyone says it is.
tree.cannot: Each step multiplies the error in your premises. Syllogists state their confidence out loud for this reason, and are trusted because of it.

tree.name: The Whole Consequence
tree.grants: The full downstream shape of a present fact — who is ruined, who profits, what ends, what must be built.
